title: Gambling SFX
description: Let's go gambling! Adds raxd's gamblecore sound effects for custom use.
body:
# Gambling SFX
A simple resource pack adding the the ability to play [raxd's gamblecore](https://youtu.be/IPFiKEm-oNI) sound effects in-game!

## Compatibility
Gambling SFX is currently compatible with [Random Item Skyblock](https://modrinth.com/modpack/random-item-skyblock).

## Sound Effects
Supports 3 sound effects:
- _"Let's go gambling!"_
- _"\*gsfx\* Aw dang it..."_
- _"Oh my- Oh my god- I won, I actually won!"_

## Usage
Gambling sounds do not replace existing sounds and are only playable with commands:

```/playsound gsfx:gambling_start master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 1```

Sound IDs: `gsfx:gambling_start`, `gsfx:gambling_win`, `gsfx:gambling_lose`
